# UCLA Sustainability

> > UCLA Sustainability coordinates sustainability initiatives, climate action, environmental health research, and educational programs across the University of California, Los Angeles campus.

This site serves as the central hub for UCLA's sustainability efforts, including the Climate Action Plan, student leadership programs, research collaborations with centers like the UC Center for Climate, Health and Equity (CCHE), and partnerships with initiatives such as Sustainable LA Grand Challenges. It features events, webinars, and educational opportunities connecting environmental justice, climate science, public health, and Indigenous knowledge.

## Key Topics

- Climate Action Plan
- Environmental Justice
- Climate Change
- Environmental Health
- UCLA Fielding School of Public Health
- UC Center for Climate, Health and Equity (CCHE)
- Sustainable LA Grand Challenges
- Student Leadership
- Wildfire Impacts
- Air Quality
- Blue Economy
- Indigenous Knowledge
- UCLA Mildred E Mathias Botanical Garden
- Sustainable Supply Chains
- Mental Health and Climate

## Climate Action & Policy

- [UCLA Student Climate Action Plan Town Hall](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/ucla-climate-action-plan-town-hall): Town hall for students on UCLA's draft Climate Action Plan and decarbonization
- [Can Abundance Be Sustainable? Affordability and Climate Policy](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/can-abundance-be-sustainable-merging-affordability-and-climate-policy): UCLA Law symposium merging affordability with climate policy and CEQA/NEPA
- [States and Nature: The Effects of Climate Change on Security](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/states-and-nature-the-effects-of-climate-change-on-security): Joshua Busby discusses climate security and violent conflict risks
- [Energy Transitions in Long Modernity (Day 2)](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/energy-transitions-in-long-modernity-day-2): Day 2 conference on energy humanities featuring Watson, Werth, and Borlik

## Environmental Health & Wildfire Response

- [The Fires 2: Hazardous Waste, Air Quality & Water Safety](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/the-fires-2-hazardous-waste-air-quality-water-safety): Coalition for Clean Air webinar on Southern California fires aftermath
- [Wildfire Impacts on Brain & Cognition](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/wildfire-impacts-on-brain-cognition): UC CCHE webinar on wildfire impacts to brain health and cognition
- [Crisis Response: Keeping Children Safe During and After Wildfires](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/crisis-response-for-kids-keeping-children-safe-during-and-after-wildfires): UC CCHE webinar on protecting children during wildfire crises
- [51st Lester Breslow Distinguished Lecture](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/51st-lester-breslow-distinguished-lecture-dr-yifang-zhu-from-invisible-to-visible-how-air-pollution-research-informs-action-in-a-changing-climate): Dr. Yifang Zhu lecture on air pollution research and climate change
- [Information Session: Intro to Ecological Medicine](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/information-session-intro-to-ecological-medicine): Info session for UCLA Medical School ecological medicine summer course

## Student Leadership & Engagement

- [Student Leadership in Housing](https://sustain.ucla.edu/housing/housing-student-leadership): Student sustainability leadership programs including Team Green in housing
- [Environmental Graduate Students Networking Reception](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/environmental-graduate-students-networking-reception): UCLA Luskin networking reception for environmental graduate students

## Sustainable Operations & Supply Chains

- [How Healthcare is Advancing Sustainable Supply Chains](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/live-webinar-from-procurement-to-disclosure-how-healthcare-is-advancing-sustainable-supply-chains): Healthcare webinar on sustainable supply chains and GHG disclosure mandates
- [2025 BECAP Summit - Workforce Solutions in the Blue Economy](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/2025-becap-summit-tides-of-transformation-advancing-workforce-solutions-in-the-blue-economy): Blue Economy Climate Action summit on workforce development solutions

## Indigenous Knowledge & Cultural Perspectives

- [Artist Panel: Indigenous Knowledge, Sustainable Future](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/artist-panel-indigenous-knowledge-sustainable-future): Fowler Museum panel on Indigenous ecological knowledge and PST ART
- [Tapia and the Construction of Early Modern Iberia](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/works-in-progress-session-earth-and-exchange-tapia-and-the-construction-of-early-modern-iberia): Rachel Schloss presents on rammed-earth construction in early modern Iberia

## Optional

- [Mathias Garden Botany Workshop: Plant Propagation](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/botany-workshop-plant-propagation): Plant propagation workshop at UCLA Mathias Botanical Garden with Keeney
- [Third Thursdays: Twilight in the Garden – September 18](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/third-thursdays-twilight-in-the-garden-september-18): Mathias Botanical Garden evening event with live music and wine bar
- [California NanoSystems Institute at UCLA Open House](https://sustain.ucla.edu/event/california-nanosystems-institute-at-ucla-open-house): CNSI open house showcasing six nanotechnology research centers at UCLA
